issues.title: FOF整批请求异常仍成功退出，已接入的systemd统计不读取其失败日志
issues.impact: 有明确FAIL日志，不能称无日志静默；但在全部请求异常而进程正常收尾的场景，本任务的systemd/日志状态通道无法识别采集失败。本轮未证明生产发生。
issues.why: collect捕获单只异常后仅计fail并打印字符串；main无条件return 0。fof_nav_collect只在UNIT_ONLY，未接TASKS/EXTRA日志扫描；该行log_anomaly固定False。包装脚本:21-24忠实传递0。
issues.fix: 保留单只best-effort；分开统计transport_errors/no_data/succeeded。attempted>0且transport_errors==attempted时返回失败或输出受监控消费的结构化degraded结果，不把合法空列表等同故障。

issues.title: 摘要同签名并发吸收不满足单行幂等
issues.impact: 两生产者同日同key同时读到空buffer，可落2行hits各1，放大摘要重复；未观察生产重复率，不影响critical直发的结论范围。
issues.why: 读buffer的共享锁在判断/追加前释放；_append_jsonl单独排他锁只防字节交错，无法原子保证“查重+hits更新/追加”。CLI main与send入口未给这一流程统一加锁。
issues.fix: 让同一排他临界区完成读取、同key判断、hits更新或追加，复用现有flock与原地重写契约；避免改用rename造成inode锁失效。

issues.title: R2全局屏障open失败后锁计划与fd列表失配
issues.impact: 锁文件权限/IO错误触发不可解释的二次异常，覆盖原错误；实际上传尚未进入。本轮未验证线上锁权限异常，也未声称发生并发覆盖。
issues.why: 域锁open成功但全局屏障open抛OSError时仅打印“仅持域锁继续”，lock_plan仍2项、fds仅1项，随后fds[1]抛IndexError。
issues.fix: 域锁或全局屏障任一打开失败统一关闭已打开fd并显式失败，保留原errno/路径；删除半初始化继续分支，减少双轨错误处理。

issues.title: fetchJSONProgress missing-Content-Length branch clears timeout and external-abort linkage before JSON body completes
issues.impact: Stalled large-response body can leave detail modal loading; 60s inner timeout and outer 15s abort no longer interrupt the body.
issues.why: Returning resp.json() without awaiting exits try immediately; finally clears _timer and removes _onOuterAbort before body parsing settles.
issues.fix: Keep body reading within try (return await resp.json()) so timeout/abort linkage lasts through response consumption; review analogous promise-returning fallback boundaries.

verifier.expected: 20ms timeout aborts stalled body, or external abort propagates; pending promise must settle or enter intended fallback.
verifier.observed: timeout_after_headers: PENDING_AFTER_80MS, innerAborted=false, activeTimers=0, fallbackCalls=0. external_abort_after_headers: same, outerAborted=true.

issues.reachability: lab.js:4959 detail modal -> _labRetestEnsureFull:4841 -> fetchLabSimFullData:4852 -> fetchJSONProgress:1862 with 60000ms. Also ranking/fusion detail loaders call it.

online_evidence.observed: 2026-11-04 06:50:39 UTC: real normal GET HTTP/2 200, content-encoding:gzip, NO Content-Length header. curl intentionally stopped by max-filesize (exit63). No full historical body downloaded. Actual production body stall/timeouts NOT observed.

issues.acceptance: Repeat absent-Content-Length fault injection: timeout and external-abort each interrupt pending body; intended timeout fallback occurs; normal streamed JSON and present-Content-Length path still complete.

over_engineering_findings.rationale: Retain existing single controller and finally; one await fixes cleanup lifetime without introducing another timer.

issues.title: Main-origin boot prefetch has no application deadline while global render awaits it
issues.impact: If main-origin boot fetch/body hangs, overview render and other tabs awaiting SIM_INDICES do not reach existing data/error fallback until browser/network eventually rejects.
issues.why: Main/localhost firstMs=0 chooses fetch with no AbortSignal. _bootJSON directly awaits that promise before any fetchJSON budget can apply.
issues.fix: Add a finite deadline covering main-origin boot response consumption, then enter existing backup/degradation path; preserve request deduplication.

trace.user_request: 先看真实index入口/加载路径

verifier.expected: Main boot has a finite application deadline and eventually settles via fallback/error.
verifier.observed: main_boot_hanging_fetch: signalAttached=false, timers=[], fallbacks=0, PENDING_AFTER_40MS. Structural absence of deadline is verified; no real production hang observed.

issues.acceptance: Simulated main boot with stalled headers and separately stalled body reaches fallback/error within declared budget; successful boot still issues one shared request.

over_engineering_findings.rationale: Reuse the existing abort/timer pattern and fallback chain; do not add a separate render-specific retry mechanism.
